Atlanta Hawks — injuries
Landale (hip) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Wizards.
A left hip strain will force Landale to miss a third straight game on Friday. Onyeka Okongwu and rookie first-round pick Zuby Ejiofor will continue to hold down the frontcourt with Landale sidelined. His next chance to suit up will come against the Nets on Saturday in the second half of Atlanta's back-to-back.
